title: Our 2025 Forecast Review
summary:
Looking back at our projections for 2025
A few years ago (against our better judgement), we started an annual forecasting tradition. At the beginning of every year, we make a number of projections about developments in the tanker market and check them at the end of the year. Against that backdrop, on January 10 th , 2025, we discussed several trends/developments that we expected to happen in the tanker market in 2025 ("Predicting The Unpredictable").
